name: Bell State
description: Preparation of the maximally entangled two-qubit Bell state |Φ⁺⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2.
long_description: The Bell state is the simplest example of quantum entanglement. A Hadamard gate places qubit 0 in superposition, and a CNOT gate creates correlation between the two qubits. Measuring one qubit instantly determines the outcome of measuring the other, regardless of distance.

references.title: Nielsen & Chuang: Quantum Computation and Quantum Information, §1.3

author: OpenQC Community
